writeup: DBPOWER's Z07 5000A jump starter with a 74Wh pack, rated for up to 10.0L gas engines, is new on Woot for $34.99 with a limit of 3 per order. AutoHive sells the same unit for $99.21 and Newegg has it at $129.99, so Woot lands about 64% under the cheapest non-Amazon store we verified. Includes jumper cables, LED light, display, and a storage case.
